content.title: Mutants of Terror
content.body:
A note I found, written by someone else in the past:

"Take the most terrible monster you can think of. Preserve it in peat and mud for ages. Let its bones slowly rot, its eyes melt into their sockets. Then have it crawl out of that mess, and here you have your Peat Mummy, a vicious creature of pure malice that can send most adventurous of ye' back into your scrawny holes.

Then take that mummy and make some impossible demon burst open and grow out of its back, and form four gigantic fleshy legs which it uses to drag around said Mummy.

Absolutely Dreadful. No one should have to face such a thing.

Aren't I a lucky Fellow?"
